Conversely δ(x)=(x=e) OR not M(x,x,e) quantifier-free defines A×{0} exactly when there is no nonzero 2-torsion, so relativization preserves rank/width. The two implications give exact least distinguishing ranks, including infinity. Independently rechecked all parity-product atoms and squares for Z/3, Z/5 and (Z/3)^2: 216, 1000, 5832 product triples. This finite test corroborates but induction proves all groups.
